name: Al Wajha
overview: Complex family relationships occur when a man marries his secretary, and refuses to confess to the marriage to satisfy his first wife, and his ex-wife gives birth to a daughter named (Amnia), while he gives birth to his first wife with his son (Zaid), whom he recognizes, and things take a serious turn when both his legitimate son and daughter grow up, without knowing that they are a brother and sister in fact.
